page.overview:
What is Dalnakya Cavern?

Dalnakya Cavern is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. A part of the Kingdom of Grandshelt's territory, it is located southwest of the Town of Mitra, near the coast. It is a passage that goes right through the mountain range dividing the main island of the Grandshelt archipelago.

According to Sophia, the cave is full of bioluminiscent plants so it is always bright, event at night.
